description: Source code for a web search provider plugin using MiniMax Search API, including functions for configuration, API interaction, and plugin creation.

methods.name: resolveMiniMaxApiKey
methods.description: Resolves the MiniMax API key from search config or environment variables.

methods.name: isMiniMaxCnHost
methods.description: Checks if a given URL or string indicates a MiniMax CN host.

methods.name: resolveMiniMaxRegion
methods.description: Determines the region ('cn' or 'global') for MiniMax based on config and environment.

methods.name: resolveMiniMaxEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the appropriate MiniMax search endpoint URL based on region.

methods.name: runMiniMaxSearch
methods.description: Performs a search request to the MiniMax API and processes the response.

methods.name: missingMiniMaxKeyPayload
methods.description: Generates an error payload when the MiniMax API key is missing.

methods.name: createMiniMaxToolDefinition
methods.description: Creates a web search tool definition for MiniMax, including execution logic.

methods.name: createMiniMaxWebSearchProvider
methods.description: Creates the MiniMax web search plugin configuration object.
